description: White background; bearded caveman A in yellow tunic with black spots at upper left, arms raised, legs mid-stride, mouth open in wide grin; right half of frame empty.
Second bearded caveman B (yellow spotted tunic) appears at right holding a pale rock aloft in raised hand; mouth open and brows angled; caveman A unchanged at left.
Both cavemen on white: A at left arms up and grinning; B at right with rock raised.

Photo-like brown dirt background replaces white; both cavemen same poses but cropped at chest as if emerging from the soil; dirt mound at lower centre; small skull at lower right; segmented worm at left edge.
Same dirt scene: A left and B right half-buried; B holds rock; mound and skull below.
White background; single caveman B at centre standing full body holding a rock in left hand with right hand on chin; frowning thinking; yellow spotted tunic.
B centred on white holding pale rock and hand on chin; frowning.

Extreme close-up of B's face at right filling frame; eye looking at rock; hand holding rock at left; rock now bright green with radiating green lines (glow). Could be zoom of same drawing or a redrawn close-up; UNRESOLVED which.
Close-up: B frowning at glowing green rock with green radiating lines held in raised hand at left.
White background; new character: caveman in brown spotted tunic standing centre waving right-hand with wide toothy grin; bearded.
Brown-tunic caveman waving and grinning at centre on white.
White rectangular name tag with handwritten text "gruG" appears on the brown tunic chest; pose unchanged.
Brown-tunic caveman waving; tag "gruG" on chest. Encoder refresh at f284 only.
Same brown caveman redrawn: eyes closed holding pale rock up to nose as if sniffing; tag absent; same position and size.
Brown caveman eyes closed sniffing rock held at face.
Brown caveman now tiny at centre lying on back on ground with rock near feet; eyes appear as X (reads as dead); much smaller scale than before.
Tiny brown caveman lying down at centre of white frame.

Painted-style sunset landscape (orange-red sky; yellow sun at left; purple hills; reddish cliff at lower left); yellow-tunic caveman at right seen in profile facing left with hands clasped behind back on white ledge.
Sunset scene with caveman standing at right hands behind back looking left.
White background; large grey rock with angry scowling face wearing purple wizard hat with yellow star at centre.
Angry rock with purple star wizard hat at centre.
Rock removed; empty white frame.
Empty white frame.
A tiny purple speck (apparently the wizard hat) appears at frame centre; only about 400 pixels changed; rock face not discernible.
White frame with a tiny purple speck at centre.
Line drawing of elderly man with glasses seated in wheelchair holding a small tablet or laptop at left; wearing jacket; white background; centre.
Man with glasses in wheelchair holding a tablet; centre.
Same man in wheelchair redrawn slightly larger and shifted left in frame; added hatching on arm and device; mouth open. UNRESOLVED whether redraw or zoom.
Larger man in wheelchair with tablet with hatching on sleeve.
Small angry rock with purple star wizard hat at centre on white; much smaller than in G0020.
Small hatted angry rock at centre.

f865-f895: small hatted rock at centre with changed fraction about 0.01 and only 1-3 px visible wobble; no size change. Final frame f896 cuts to large angry rock without hat screaming with sound lines at left. UNRESOLVED whether jitter is an intentional vibrate.
Large pale rock at left with angry brows and black open mouth yelling with three sound lines at right; right half empty.
Second rock appears at right facing the first: scowling brows and large black open mouth; sweat marks and a puff at right edge; sound lines between rocks.
Two yelling rocks facing each other; left calmer scale and right larger with puff.
Cartoon mushroom cloud with yellow cap and orange-red stem and burst lines at base; centred on white.
Mushroom cloud at centre. Encoder refresh at f1118.
Mushroom cloud same drawing abruptly tiny at frame centre (about 5% frame width); white background.
Tiny mushroom cloud at centre.
Same mushroom cloud scaled up to about 45% of frame height; centred.
Medium-size mushroom cloud at centre.
Same mushroom cloud scaled larger again; cap near top and base cropped at bottom edge.
Large mushroom cloud filling most of frame height.
Line-drawn volcano erupting with red lava streaks; white smoke cloud above and small puffs; burst lines; white background.
Erupting volcano with red lava and smoke puff.

Red lava pool at lower left; wavy heat lines; at right a stern caveman with feather headband holds a small screaming caveman overhead with arms flailing. Later hold shows composition a little larger and shifted left; possible short zoom UNRESOLVED.
Lava pool at left; stern caveman at right lifting screaming caveman overhead.
Caveman in yellow hard hat holding hammer in raised right hand and another tool at hip; yellow spotted tunic; grim face; faint grey ghost edge behind.
Hard-hat caveman with hammer standing centre. Encoder refresh at f1420.
Caveman with exposed brain on head holding a stone tablet with arrow and hourglass-like symbols; yellow spotted tunic; grumpy face.
Brain-head caveman reading the tablet.
Single grey metal tube tilted at centre with small shine lines at upper left and lower right.
Grey tube with shine lines.
Pile of nine gold coins each stamped with a caveman face; centred.
Pile of nine caveman-face gold coins. Encoder refresh at f1720.
Angry hatted rock (purple wizard hat with star) at left of frame; right two-thirds empty.
Hatted angry rock at left.
Curved black arrow appears above and right of the rock pointing right.
Hatted rock at left with curved arrow pointing right.
Large smiling round face (two black oval eyes and wide smile with a curved shine line) appears at right of the arrow.
Hatted rock then arrow then smiley ball left to right.
Rock and arrow removed; smiley ball now at left of frame at same size; layout reset. UNRESOLVED if instantaneous reposition or cut.
Smiley ball alone at left.
Curved black arrow appears to the right of the smiley ball.
Smiley ball at left with arrow pointing right.
Grey tube with shine lines appears at right end of the arrow.
Smiley ball then arrow then grey tube.
Smiley ball redrawn: closed U-shaped eyes and downturned open mouth (sleeping) with text "zZ" above right; ball at upper-left of frame; arrow and tube unchanged.
Sleeping face with zZ then arrow then grey tube.
Bearded man with glasses in white lab coat with chest pocket standing at right holding a small red button device in raised hand; cable trailing on ground to right edge; barefoot.
Lab-coat scientist holding red button; cable on ground.
Close-up drawing of a fist gripping a small box with red button at right; sleeve extends to right edge; cable hangs below.
Close-up of hand gripping red-button box.
Black uppercase handwritten text "“CLICKY" appears upper left; hand moved leftward; text ends with opening quote only.
Text "CLICKY above hand holding button.
Second line "CLICKY" appears below the first.
Two lines: "CLICKY / CLICKY.
Third line "FIRE" appears below.
Three lines: CLICKY / CLICKY / FIRE.
Fourth line "NOW" with closing quote appears; text block now four lines at left of hand.
Complete quote CLICKY CLICKY FIRE NOW on four lines beside hand.
Return to full-body lab-coat scientist with red button, now wearing large purple wizard hat with several yellow stars; cable on ground; scientist at right.
Scientist with wizard hat holding button.
Two large hands from both sides cupping a rock with furious face: scowling brows and open mouth with teeth; shake lines above and below.
Hands squeezing angry rock; shake lines.
Rock face now closed eyes and gentle smile; shake lines removed; hands same.
Hands cupping calm smiling rock.
White background; caveman with long black hair and bangs stands arms crossed with angry frown; yellow spotted tunic; centre.
Angry arms-crossed caveman in yellow tunic.
Same pose and position but tunic colour and spots removed; now outline-only garment with belt and wristbands (line drawing without fill).
Colourless arms-crossed caveman with belt.

Colourless caveman stays still at left. From f2520 a bearded yellow-tunic caveman with palms out slides in from right edge across about 60 frames reaching centre-right adjacent to him; in-between frames present and motion decelerates toward the end (changed fraction peaks 0.061 at f2552 then falls).
Arms-crossed colourless caveman at left; yellow-tunic bearded caveman leaning toward him with palms forward.
Both redrawn: left man shouting with mouth wide open and small puff cloud with lines above head; right man now facing viewer with both hands raised palms out and worried frown.
Left man yelling with steam puff over head; right man hands raised. Encoder refresh at f2620.
Pale bomb with fins and yellow radiation trefoil symbol at centre; line drawn.
Bomb with radiation symbol.
Mushroom cloud explosion (same drawing as G0036) centred.
Mushroom cloud at centre.
Mushroom cloud removed; empty white frame.
Empty white frame.
Full-frame cut from white to solid black.
Solid black frame.
Blue crescent moon with grinning face and teeth appears at right of centre on black.

Smiling blue crescent moon on black, settled left of centre; the 1-frame G0104 state (f2913) showed it right of centre, so the moon arrives as a 2-step placement (hold f2914-2955 static: px_diff 84, no D4).
White background with yellow smiling sun with spiky rays and toothy grin at centre.
Yellow smiling sun at centre.
Close-up of long-haired bearded caveman with huge round eyes streaming tears and mouth wide open in shock; yellow tunic strap at lower right.
Crying shocked close-up caveman.
Same close-up redrawn with thick black sunglasses covering eyes; mouth closed with slight smirk; beard same.
Close-up bearded caveman wearing black sunglasses with smirk.
Large mushroom cloud base at left with burst lines; at right a bearded yellow-tunic caveman stands facing left with frown.
Cloud base at left; caveman standing at right.
Caveman replaced by a skeleton wearing black sunglasses standing at same position; cloud and lines unchanged.
Skeleton with sunglasses beside the cloud base.
Tiny yellow-tunic caveman at centre of white frame (about 3% frame height).
Tiny caveman at centre.
Bearded caveman running to left with mouth open and arm out; speed lines; flame at right chasing him; ground line under feet; white background.
Caveman running away from fire.
Bald beardless caveman in yellow tunic standing centre with frown and arms down.
Bald frowning caveman.
Same body now with black hair and beard; hand at mouth coughing; small cough lines at left.
Coughing bearded caveman.
Same coughing drawing at about 85% of previous scale; same pose and position near centre.
Smaller coughing caveman (0.16 s hold).
Tiny bearded yellow-tunic caveman lying on back with X eyes; at centre; reuse of the lying pose seen in G0016 with different tunic.
Tiny caveman lying down.
Large stern bearded caveman in yellow tunic with right index finger raised; centre.
Caveman with raised finger. Encoder refresh at f3474.
Four figures in a row: two bearded men and a long-haired woman and a small child in yellow tunics; all frowning and pointing thumbs down toward left.
Four tribe members with thumbs down.
Ten bombs with radiation symbols in two rows of five.
Ten radiation bombs.

Left: caveman in green tunic running carrying a radiation-symbol ball overhead; centre: pyramid pile of radiation balls; right: caveman with green feather headdress laughing on stone throne with arms up.
Green tribe scene: carrier then ball pile then laughing chief. Encoder refresh at f3774.
Two large cavemen: left yellow tunic talking with mouth open and hand raised; right with green feather headband hand on chin and other on hip.
Yellow caveman talking and green-feather caveman pondering (3.8 s hold).
Both redrawn: left now faces right with hand extended; right shrugs with both arms out and closed eyes; positions slightly shifted.
Two cavemen conversing: left hand out; right shrugging.
Single bearded yellow-tunic caveman centre laughing with mouth wide open and both arms raised; the following hold shows head tilted and hands higher so one extra pose step exists.
Laughing caveman arms raised with head tilted. Encoder refresh at f4074.
Large grumpy bearded caveman standing looking left; yellow tunic; arms down; faint pale smudges at feet.
Grumpy caveman standing.
Long spear lying horizontally with arrowhead at right end only.
Spear with one head.
Second arrowhead appears at left end of spear making it double-ended.
Double-ended spear. Encoder refresh at f4374.
Bearded caveman wearing a graduation mortarboard cap at right pointing chalk at a black board with white text "LESSON" at upper left.
Professor caveman with LESSON board.
Two yelling rocks facing each other (same layout as G0035): left rock mouth open with sound lines; right rock larger with puff.
Two yelling rocks.
Thick red X appears over both rocks.
Rocks crossed out by red X.
Small campfire on logs with orange flame at centre of white frame.
Campfire. Encoder refresh at f4684 only.
Bearded yellow-tunic caveman appears at left with frown holding a burger on a stick over the campfire at right; fire moved lower right.
Caveman roasting a burger at the fire.
Close-up bearded caveman at right glancing at glowing green rock in raised hand at left with green radiating lines; hand on chin; similar to G0008 but redrawn slightly.
Close-up caveman with glowing green rock; face cropped at top.
Globe of Earth with black land masses with orange flames on top; small; at centre of white frame.
Flaming Earth globe.
Globe and flames begin to fade: colour goes from black to grey across 5 frames; position and size unchanged.
Fade-out continues: first tile mid-grey globe; mid tile pale grey; last tile fully blank white (ENDING_STATE).
